groups.title: alpine_guardian
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Snowy granite cliff sanctuaries share monumental carved guardians and exposed high-alpine stone.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Snowy granite cliff sanctuaries share monumental carved guardians and exposed high-alpine stone.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Seasonal snow patterns vary without changing the stone-and-guardian identity.

groups.title: amber_canopy_biosphere
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Luminous green or amber tree-like cores sit inside domed or sealed research bays with modular wall labs and shared containment architecture.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Luminous green or amber tree-like cores sit inside domed or sealed research bays with modular wall labs and shared containment architecture.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: One amber tree is more natural and open; the rest are controlled chambers.

groups.title: amber_fossil_vault
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Warm amber and ochre fossil chambers repeat ammonite or rib forms, stalactites, stepped galleries and large dark central hollows across Subterranean Worlds and Schedule Worker Plan.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Warm amber and ochre fossil chambers repeat ammonite or rib forms, stalactites, stepped galleries and large dark central hollows across Subterranean Worlds and Schedule Worker Plan.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Fossil scale and the balance of mineral spires versus bone differ; inspect the least fossil-heavy members and split if the common fossil cue is too weak.

groups.title: amethyst_escarpment
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Open purple crystal cliffs share a sunset palette, exposed rock and narrow canyon bridges.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Open purple crystal cliffs share a sunset palette, exposed rock and narrow canyon bridges.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Primary theme is material_physics because the scenes are open geological landscapes.

groups.title: autumn_root_canyons
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Five elevated root crossings bridge dry cliff gaps under clear or pink skies, without the low waterline of the marsh maps.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Five elevated root crossings bridge dry cliff gaps under clear or pink skies, without the low waterline of the marsh maps.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Keep separate from autumn marsh and root-water scenes.

groups.title: autumn_rootlands
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Warm wetland maps share low root bridges, shallow reflective water and autumn foliage.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Warm wetland maps share low root bridges, shallow reflective water and autumn foliage.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Keep elevated dry root canyons and muted coastal mangroves separate.

groups.title: autumn_stone_causeways
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Weathered stone causeways span gray-brown ravines beneath sparse autumn trees, with similar open valleys and bridge silhouettes.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Weathered stone causeways span gray-brown ravines beneath sparse autumn trees, with similar open valleys and bridge silhouettes.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Single and parallel bridge structures differ, but the material and season match.

groups.title: brackwater_liftworks
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Waterwheels, turbine halls, spillways, green channels and service galleries recur across industrial maps with compatible plant-scale architecture.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Waterwheels, turbine halls, spillways, green channels and service galleries recur across industrial maps with compatible plant-scale architecture.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Several members are exact duplicate exports; the layouts vary from wheel rooms to sluiceways.

groups.title: bright_root_marsh
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Two brighter fantasy marsh maps continue exposed-root crossings with lush green shelves and an enchanted palette.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Two brighter fantasy marsh maps continue exposed-root crossings with lush green shelves and an enchanted palette.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Keep separate from muted coastal mangroves and warm autumn wetlands.

groups.title: chalk_fissure
groups.major_visual_characteristics: White chalk walls contrast with narrow black fissures, falling scree and sparse ledges in a shared deep-rock setting.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: White chalk walls contrast with narrow black fissures, falling scree and sparse ledges in a shared deep-rock setting.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Some members read as cutaways and others as open chasms; chalk and fissures anchor the level identity.

groups.title: chalkroot_vale
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Pale limestone or chalk cliffs, grass-topped shelves, shallow water and exposed root crossings form a consistent open valley vocabulary.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Pale limestone or chalk cliffs, grass-topped shelves, shallow water and exposed root crossings form a consistent open valley vocabulary.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Some pieces show a sinkhole while others are open river canyons; verify the sinkhole member can serve the same valley.

groups.title: cinderfall_hollow
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Basalt lava chambers share orange magma, dark rock and stepped passages.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Basalt lava chambers share orange magma, dark rock and stepped passages.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Dry amber calcite image-0371 is assigned to ochre_karst_caverns.

groups.title: crystal_cascade_rootwood
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Blue-purple crystal caverns share luminous waterfalls, rootwood paths and basin-scale traversal; two attachment images are exact copies of their later refinements.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Blue-purple crystal caverns share luminous waterfalls, rootwood paths and basin-scale traversal; two attachment images are exact copies of their later refinements.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Only two distinct image byte identities are present; the exact copies are preserved as provenance aliases, not extra sections.

groups.title: cyan_karst_halls
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Cyan bioluminescent limestone halls form a consistent illuminated karst family.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Cyan bioluminescent limestone halls form a consistent illuminated karst family.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Lighting and color differ from the gray unlit limestone halls.

groups.title: desalination_tidal_cut

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Three coastal desalination plants overlook broad drained tidal cuts, with tanks, service decks and maintenance routes.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Industrial plants share a setting but no exact edge alignment is implied.

groups.title: emberfoundry_cascade
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Molten crucibles, dark steel decks, orange slag basins, cranes and furnace platforms recur in the foundry maps; exact duplicate copies remain separate files.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Molten crucibles, dark steel decks, orange slag basins, cranes and furnace platforms recur in the foundry maps; exact duplicate copies remain separate files.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Some images show open slag pits while others are enclosed foundries; split if the industrial sections do not feel like one complex.

groups.title: fractured_ring_outposts

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Exterior red-mesa ring sites share broken artifact structures beneath planetary skies.

groups.title: frostfall_galleries

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Two enclosed blue-gray icefall galleries share dense icy walls and interior light.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Open snow-covered ruins are assigned to snowbound_tuff_plaza.

groups.title: frozen_marl_slopes
groups.major_visual_characteristics: Blue-gray winter marl and exposed gravel fans form a colder sediment family distinct from brown glacial cutaways.
groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Blue-gray winter marl and exposed gravel fans form a colder sediment family distinct from brown glacial cutaways.

groups.title: gothic_sunset_causeway

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Gothic towers, stained glass, suspended bridges and rose-orange canyon light recur; the second pair are byte-identical refinement copies of the first pair.

groups.title: lacuna_iceworks

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Dense purple crystal research labs share modular science structures and bright frozen geology.

groups.title: lacuna_underice_ring

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Sparse black-blue ring laboratories under ice share a restrained orbital-research scale and dark palette.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Keep separate from the dense purple crystal research labs.

groups.title: marl_lens

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Brown glacial cutaways share coarse till, layered sediment and broad cavities.

groups.title: mistbound_industrial_cavern

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Green-hazed cavern factories repeat rusted tanks, industrial walkways, arches and water below a distant ruined skyline.

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Eight mossy cave-ruin traversals share pale stone arches, green ledges, ladders, water and the same blue cavern backdrop.

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Pale alpine cliff ruins, purple flowers and distant blue ranges share a high-mountain sanctuary setting.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Architecture varies by ruin, but the alpine palette and cliff scale are consistent.

groups.title: ochre_karst_caverns

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Warm gold calcite chambers, shafts of light and terraced cave routes form a coherent non-fossil karst region.
groups.potential_incompatibilities: Retain the fossil-specific amber vault as a separate motif family.

groups.title: orbital_assembly_hangars

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Remaining maps share large spacecraft assembly halls, overhead gantries and modular outposts.

groups.title: pale_limestone_halls

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Gray unlit limestone halls share pale stone and subdued cave lighting.

groups.title: porous_reef_lagoons

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Both scenes combine knotted roots or honeycombed pale stone, low water and small natural arches in a warm, shallow lagoon setting.

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Three red-gray eroded basin cutaways share layered strata, gravel falls and comparable exposed cross-sections.

groups.why_plausibly_one_level: Red and cream sediment layers descend into pale saltpan floors with shallow blue groundwater or runoff channels across two conversations.
